source.title: Comparison of Cardiovascular Outcomes Between Dapagliflozin and Empagliflozin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: A Meta-Analysis

duplicate_review.finding: No duplicate atom IDs or duplicate source assertions were retained.

consistency_review.finding: Endpoint-specific denominators differ because cardiovascular mortality and stroke pooled only three of the four included studies; this distinction is preserved.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is oriented toward primary literature and has no dedicated systematic-review/meta-analysis atom kind. Meta-analysis methods and pooled results were represented with existing method, quantitative_result, limitation, author_conclusion, and other supported kinds.
source_gaps: README(2).md, named in the project ATOM macro, was not present among the loaded project sources or the ORACLE folder. Governing authority therefore used literature.py → literature_atoms.py → literature_atom.schema.json; example_atom.json was used only as an illustrative scaffold.
